limitations: Every corrected RMS value in this report is measured from the supplied new-curve render. References are separately measured actual device-OFF audio.
All four source signals are deterministic synthetic waveforms; these results do not establish exact compensation for arbitrary real material.
RMS matching does not guarantee equal perceived loudness.
Fixed-parameter offline rendering does not verify physical controller timing, takeover, or runtime parameter updates.
Native Output is limited to -36..0 dB. Any positive desired correction near Drive 0 is bounded at 0 dB.
Live export normalization and Set conditions must be independently verified in Live.

deployed_runtime_validation.subjective_listening_feedback: User reported no noticeable level steps during fast Drive movement on the synthetic bass test Set.

legacy_drive_zero_reference.reason_replaced: The old demonstration initialized Output to -12 dB and inherited it as trim, causing a 12 dB bypass jump.

limitations: Calibration depends on waveform, input level and fixed settings.
